editorial_cautions: CNI means Centre national des indépendants et paysans; CID means Nicoud's Comité d’information et de défense. They are different political actors.
The Socialist Party's nationalization case should distinguish already-public SNIAS from private Dassault and the specific 1981 public-stake proposal.
The PCF's documented position did not equal automatic nuclear disarmament; distinguish critique of the deterrent doctrine from a game-state weapon removal.
The National Front did not exist at the January 1970 start; use its branch only from its 1972 founding date.
Company sources support technical and corporate dates, not independent claims about party intent or historical effects.
